title: Venue
description: One hawker centre, food court, or cafe. Lives in data/venues.json (index, all venues) and is the source for the per-venue file at data/venues/<slug>.json once stalls exist.

slug.description: URL identity. Never changes even if the venue is renamed or reclassified -- reclassifying a cafe as a food court must not change its URL.

type.description: Scope is hawker centres, food courts and cafes only. No restaurants.

region.description: One of the five official URA planning regions -- not an informal compass direction. Omit (do not guess) until classified against real boundary data.

stall_count_nea.description: From the NEA dataset, where available. Not the same as stalls_documented.

stalls_documented.description: Computed from how many stall records exist for this venue. Never hand-typed.

verified.description: Date this venue record was last checked against a real source. Every venue and stall record carries this; a record past its re-check deadline displays as stale.

moved_to.description: Set only on a tombstoned venue record that has been superseded by a new one. Records are never deleted.
